question: How many public colleges are in Ohio?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM institutions WHERE state = 'OH' AND control = 'Public'

question: What was Ohio State's total enrollment in 2023?
gold_sql: WITH matched_institution AS (SELECT m.unit_id FROM institutions m JOIN fall_enrollment f ON f.unit_id = m.unit_id WHERE m.name ILIKE '%ohio state university%' AND f.year = 2023 AND f.level = 'All students' ORDER BY f.total_students DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT f.total_students FROM matched_institution mi JOIN fall_enrollment f ON f.unit_id = mi.unit_id WHERE f.year = 2023 AND f.level = 'All students'

question: How has University of Michigan's undergraduate enrollment changed from 2021 to 2023?
gold_sql: WITH matched_institution AS (SELECT m.unit_id FROM institutions m JOIN fall_enrollment f ON f.unit_id = m.unit_id WHERE m.name ILIKE '%university of michigan%' AND f.year = 2023 AND f.level = 'All students' ORDER BY f.total_students DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT f.year, f.total_students FROM matched_institution mi JOIN fall_enrollment f ON f.unit_id = mi.unit_id WHERE f.level = 'Undergraduate' AND f.year IN (2021, 2023) ORDER BY f.year

question: Which public universities in Ohio had a six-year graduation rate above 80% in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT i.name, g.grad_rate_pct FROM institutions i JOIN graduation_rates g ON i.unit_id = g.unit_id WHERE i.state = 'OH' AND i.control = 'Public' AND g.cohort_type = 'bachelor_or_equivalent' AND g.year = 2023 AND g.grad_rate_pct > 80 ORDER BY g.grad_rate_pct DESC

question: How did out-of-state undergraduate tuition at Ohio State change from 2021 to 2023?
